title: City of Winter
sourceAnomalies: The Mask Maker deck contains 24 cards where every other deck contains 25 (249 tradition cards total). Confirmed independently against CoW-TraditionCards.pdf, whose 250 pages are the 249 tradition cards plus the X-Card. Owner-confirmed 2026-08-12.

The gutterfold print-and-play sheets differ from the printed cards on 13 of the 249 faces. Owner ruling 2026-08-12: the PRINTED CARDS are authoritative, and the corpus follows them; the print-and-play wording is kept on each affected card as ^“PnP Prompt”. See build/card-errata.json. Four are genuinely different prompts — the PnP duplicates ‘who joins the Umbra’ and ‘a lie of the Umbra’, and so omits ‘how we fight the Umbra’ and ‘why we fear the Umbra’ entirely.
Wintermount appears on the City Transit Map (p.38, Moon Path) and has its own location page (p.37), but is absent from the Transit Distance table (p.40). Open — owner following up.

The Transit Distance table (Atlas p.40) is not consistent with the City Transit Map (Glowtown-Undertown 1, Undertown-Husk 1, Glowtown-Husk 7+). Owner ruling 2026-08-12: THE TABLE IS AUTHORITATIVE; travel and migration reach are computed from it, not from the line topology.

The rules give the deck count as 11 (p.8) and as ten (p.52). Not a contradiction: it depends what is counted. The box holds the X-Card, an initial deck naming each tradition, and the 10 tradition decks (9 traditions + the Umbra). Owner ruling 2026-08-12.

‘Glowdog of the Dust’ (p.52) names a starting Home whose Atlas page carries no Glowdog icon. Not an anomaly: the Dust’s icons are a blank circle and a blank diamond, Glowdog is a diamond deck, and the Blank Tradition Icons rule (p.38) permits it. Owner ruling 2026-08-12.

The location is spelled ‘The Wandering Burrough’ on its card and ‘Wandering Borough’ in the rules text. Owner ruling 2026-08-12: BURROUGH is correct; the corpus names the location that way and leaves the rules quotations verbatim.

Atlas page cross-references on p.9 (‘We Join a Caravan (p.12)’, actually p.11) and p.16 (‘Glowtown (p.19)’, actually p.22) are wrong. Tracked here only; page numbers are carried per location as ATLAS_PAGE and are not surfaced to players.
